Handling Failed / Stuck Recharge Transactions

Document ID: SOP_C03_RECHARGE_FAILURE

Category: C03 — Recharge & Payments

Department: Finance

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Purpose

To define the standard procedure for diagnosing and resolving recharge transactions where payment was debited but not credited to the customer account.

Scope

Applies to all prepaid and postpaid recharge channels: app, web self-care, UPI, cards, net banking, and retail POS.

Procedure

Verify the transaction reference ID and debit confirmation provided by the customer.

Check transaction status in the Payment Reconciliation Dashboard.

If status is 'Pending', advise the customer that auto-reconciliation typically completes within 60 minutes.

If unresolved after 24 hours, raise a manual reconciliation ticket to the Payments Ops team.

If the gateway confirms the debit but NovaTel has no record within 48 hours, process a goodwill account-balance credit pending final reconciliation, and flag for audit.

Close the ticket only once the customer confirms plan/balance is credited, or the amount is refunded to source.

Exceptions

Transactions flagged as suspected fraud are routed to SOP_C18_FRAUD_RESPONSE instead of standard reconciliation.

Retail POS cash transactions follow the Retail Cash Reconciliation SOP (out of scope here).
